name: iscsicpl.exe
description: Microsoft iSCSI Initiator Control Panel tool
author: Ekitji

commands.description: c:\windows\syswow64\iscsicpl.exe has a DLL injection through `C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\ISCSIEXE.dll`, resulting in UAC bypass.
commands.usecase: Execute a custom DLL via a trusted high-integrity process without a UAC prompt.

commands.description: Both `c:\windows\system32\iscsicpl.exe` and `c:\windows\system64\iscsicpl.exe` have UAC bypass through launching iscicpl.exe, then navigating into the Configuration tab, clicking Report, then launching your custom command.
commands.usecase: Execute a binary or script as a high-integrity process without a UAC prompt.

detection: Suspicious child process to iscsicpl.exe like cmd, powershell etc.
